$description: MenuBar (platform/components/MenuBar, issue 805): a bordered row of menu buttons (File, Edit, View). The menu's own surface roles; no new color.

menubar-background.$description: MenuBar: the bar's fill, the menu's.

menubar-border-color.$description: MenuBar: the bar's border, the subtle border role.

menubar-border-width.$description: MenuBar: the bar's border width, the subtle border role.

menubar-radius.$description: MenuBar: the bar's corners, the menu's.

menubar-padding.$description: MenuBar: the space between the border and the first and last menu button.

menubar-gap.$description: MenuBar: the space between two menu buttons.
